instruction: Test it how often the new paths can interpret unfamiliar prose and prove relationships across documents. Call it scout

Passed 41 focused tests and the documentation audit.
limitations: The sample covers short English diplomatic records and was scored by one AI-assisted operator. No configured model ran.
The full repository ZIP exceeds local extraction space. This pilot checks the current engine without changing it.
next_steps: Develop independently worded controls for comparing recommendations rather than wording and test verified scope warnings on partial outputs.
